description: Weight-window variance reduction for the nf-bnct-001 frozen benchmark: neutron and photon windows on the 40x40x40 scoring mesh, lower bounds derived from each particle's diagnostic fluence tally of a dedicated analog run (MAGIC-equivalent normalization).
provenance_note: MAGIC-style forward-flux derivation: per energy group the volume-normalized tally mean scaled by 1/(2 * group_max) becomes the lower bound; cells whose tally relative error exceeds 0.5 are disabled. Energy groups match the case's diagnostic fluence grids so no re-binning occurs. v3: forward-flux bounds iterated from the 20M-history VR statepoint; photon window bound_boosts lowers bounds 30x over the WW cells containing the central_axis_2cm precision-gated region to force photon splitting there; max_split raised (photon 200, neutron 50).
